hero.title: JOIDY
hero.subtitle: Private. Self-hosted. Your knowledge, your rules.

whatIs.title: What is Joidy?
whatIs.description: A private, self-hosted PKM system that turns notes into XP, an evolving plant, and a living knowledge graph — on your hardware, under your control.

pillars.title: Notes → XP
pillars.desc: Every note, edit, and connection generates experience points. Your knowledge becomes a game.

pillars.title: 100% Private
pillars.desc: Self-hosted on your machine. Zero cloud, zero tracking. Your data never leaves your network.

pillars.title: Living Graph
pillars.desc: Automatic connections between notes, tags, and skills. Discover relationships you never knew existed.

problem.title: The Problem
before: Scattered notes with zero connections between them
No motivation to maintain the writing habit
No visibility into your own learning progress
Your data trapped in proprietary clouds
after: Every note automatically linked, classified, searchable by meaning
XP, streaks, and plant evolution make note-taking a daily habit
Real-time graph shows what you know and what you don't
Your data stays on your machine. 100% yours, 100% private.

privacy.title: Privacy & Self-Hosting
privacy.description: Your knowledge is the most valuable thing you own. It should not live on someone else's server.

points.title: Your Data, Your Hardware
points.desc: Joidy runs entirely on your machine via Docker Compose. No cloud dependency, no third party.

points.title: Zero Telemetry
points.desc: No analytics, no tracking, no phone-home. What you write is what stays.

points.title: Local AI, Optional Cloud
points.desc: Use Ollama for fully local AI. No API key required. Cloud AI (Gemini, OpenAI) only if you choose.

points.title: PostgreSQL on Your Disk
points.desc: Postgres 16 + pgvector in a local container. Dump it, back it up, encrypt it — your database is yours to control.

items.title: Gamification
items.desc: XP events, streaks, an evolving plant (seed → tree), and achievements persisted in PostgreSQL. Every note levels you up.
items.highlight: No other PKM turns knowledge into growth

items.title: Knowledge Graph
items.desc: Tag co-occurrence visualization revealing hidden connections across your vault.
items.highlight: Connections no other tool shows you

items.title: Skill Tree
items.desc: Auto-generated from your tags. Watch your expertise grow and branch as you write.
items.highlight: Skills that evolve in real time

items.title: Semantic Search
items.desc: Vector search with pgvector (PostgreSQL 16). Find notes by meaning, not just keywords.
items.highlight: Search by meaning, not by keyword

items.title: AI Assistant
items.desc: Chat with your notes at /ai, auto-tagging, and semantic RAG. 6 providers: Gemini, OpenAI, Anthropic, Cohere, Ollama, OpenRouter (+ OpenAI-compatible).
items.highlight: Your AI, your rules, your hardware

items.title: Goals & Objectives
items.desc: Priorities, linked notes, one-off tasks, archiving, and rollover/snowball/daily-reset modes. Auto-suggested icons. Streaks that never fail.
items.highlight: Goals that adapt to your rhythm

items.title: Streaks & Mood
items.desc: Configurable streaks with check-ins, freezes, and categories — plus a daily mood check-in with history and stats.

items.title: Obsidian Sync
items.desc: Bidirectional sync — filesystem watcher plus instant webhook push. If you have a vault, Joidy enhances it.

items.title: Calendar & Tasks
items.desc: Google Calendar is live: incremental sync, local cache, and a monthly view — plus plannable tasks with priorities, recurrence, and reminders.

items.title: Pomodoro Timer
items.desc: +15 XP per completed session, with multiple clock and timer styles.

items.title: Integrations Hub
items.desc: GitHub sync, unified Gmail inbox via n8n, and a Telegram quick-capture bot — with Spotify & Strava OAuth scaffolding.

items.title: Push & Offline
items.desc: Installable PWA with web-push notifications and an offline mode that syncs when you're back.

demo.title: See It in Action
demo.description: One command to install, one to launch. Joidy runs as a self-hosted web app on your own hardware — this is what it actually looks like.
demo.terminalCaption: joidy — the CLI that orchestrates the whole stack

audience.title: Who Is It For?

items.title: Privacy-Conscious Users
items.desc: People who refuse to trade their knowledge for free cloud services.

items.title: Knowledge Workers
items.desc: Professionals managing large volumes of interconnected information.

items.title: Developers
items.desc: Who want an open-source, self-hosted PKM they can trust and extend.

items.title: Researchers & Students
items.desc: Who need to connect ideas across disciplines and uncover hidden relationships.

audience.message: 100% open-source · self-hosted · your control, your data

items.a: Yes. 100% open-source (GPL v3). Self-hosted. You control everything.
No. Obsidian integration is native, but the web UI works without it.
Everything stays on your machine — a local PostgreSQL database in your own Docker volume. No cloud, no tracking, no telemetry.

items.q: Can I use it from my phone?
items.a: Yes. Joidy is an installable PWA (offline mode + push notifications), and the Telegram bot lets you capture notes, goals, and mood check-ins from anywhere.

items.q: How does the XP system work?
items.a: Flat XP per action: +10 per note, +5 per edit, +15 daily activity, +50 per completed goal, +15 per pomodoro. Streak milestones (7/30/100/365 days) award +100 XP, and your plant evolves from seed to tree.
Only for cloud AI (Gemini, OpenAI, Anthropic, Cohere, OpenRouter). Ollama runs fully local. Core features need none.
No. Joidy is self-hosted. No central server, no access. That is the entire point.
Absolutely. GitHub. PRs, issues, ideas welcome.
SvelteKit, FastAPI, PostgreSQL + pgvector, and 6 AI providers. Docker Compose orchestration.

footer.tagline: A disciplined progression system. Private, open-source, and hosted on your own machine.
